Features / Understand
◈ Understand

The AI that reads your codebase
before it touches a single line.

Before any planning, any code generation, any review — Brunelly builds a deep, persistent understanding of your entire project. Technical architecture and business context together, in one place, from day one.

◈

Why this matters for complex systems: Generic AI tools respond to what you type. Brunelly understands what you've built — the decisions that led there, the constraints that shape it, and the goals that drive it. That understanding is the foundation every other capability is built on.

◈ Smart Onboarding

Pick up any codebase.
Brunelly reads it. So your team doesn't have to.

Whether you're starting a greenfield project or inheriting a complex brownfield system, Brunelly onboards itself. It imports your repository, reads what exists, identifies gaps, and gets your team building with confidence — in minutes, not weeks.

✓
Import existing repositories or start from a blank idea — both fully supported
✓
Reads your codebase, documents what exists, and highlights gaps and opportunities
✓
Clear suggestions on how to extend, improve, or rebuild with full architectural awareness
✓
Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and Bitbucket — no migration required
✓
New engineers onboard faster — Brunelly carries the institutional knowledge so they don't have to rebuild it
◈ Codebase Intelligence

Your codebase, fully documented and searchable in plain language.

Brunelly generates comprehensive architecture documentation, component guides, and FAQs directly from your code — and keeps them up to date as your system evolves. Ask questions about your system in natural language, get answers grounded in the actual code.

✓
Auto-generated architecture docs, component guides, and FAQs from your live codebase
✓
Natural language search across code, documents, and work items simultaneously
✓
Explore project structure and read files directly from the chat interface
✓
Tech stack understanding — Brunelly learns your stack and provides context-aware guidance
✓
Documentation stays current — updates automatically as your code evolves, no manual effort
◈ Persistent Context

Decisions made in sprint one still inform sprint twenty.

Brunelly doesn't just read your code once — it maintains a living memory of your project. Architecture decisions, constraints, business goals and technical patterns accumulate over time, so every sprint benefits from everything that came before it.

✓
Context never resets — decisions accumulate and evolve as your project grows
✓
Architecture patterns and constraints are always available to every AI agent
✓
Business goals stay connected to technical decisions at every stage
✓
Every team member works from the same shared understanding — always in sync
